name: page-values
description: People-and-values section of the 2026 company pages (Our Company, Figma 7455:103802): a header row (eyebrow, heading with a gradient phrase, lede; an arrow link on the right), then a list of icon points (40px icon, bold line, short text) beside a rounded photo.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title_accent.description: Words of the heading painted with the brand gradient (first occurrence); must appear in title.

lede.description: Copy under the heading. Blank line = new paragraph; [label](url) links, **bold**.

link_label.description: Arrow link at the right of the header row. Renders only with link_url.

items.description: Points. Each: icon (40px image URL; empty = no icon), title (h3), text (short copy; [label](url), **bold**).

image.description: Photo beside the points (cropped to 3:2, 16px corners). Empty = points only.

image_width.description: Photo intrinsic width in px (0 omits it).
